question: 'Pankhida' songs are sung by peasants of _____ while working on the fields.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankhida is a traditional folk song** form originating from Rajasthan, India.
 
• The word '**Pankhida'** literally translates to **'lover'** in the local dialect.
 
• Pankhida songs are typically accompanied by traditional instruments like the **Algoza, and the Manjira.**
 
• The songs often involve a **call-and-response format**, where a lead singer performs a verse followed by a chorus from the group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
